; Assembly code for a simple 2D game
; Function: _start
_start:
    mov ax, 0
    call init_graphics
    call game_loop
    ret

; Function: init_graphics
init_graphics:
    push bp
    mov bp, sp
    mov ax, 0x13
    int 0x10
    pop bp
    ret

; Function: game_loop
game_loop:
    push bp
    mov bp, sp
.loop:
    call handle_input
    call update_player
    call draw_sprite
    call check_collision
    jmp .loop
    pop bp
    ret

; Function: handle_input
handle_input:
    push bp
    mov bp, sp
    mov ah, 0x01
    int 0x16
    jz .no_key
    mov ah, 0x00
    int 0x16
    cmp al, 'w'
    je .up
    cmp al, 's'
    je .down
    cmp al, 'a'
    je .left
    cmp al, 'd'
    je .right
.no_key:
    pop bp
    ret
.up:
    ; handle up
    pop bp
    ret
.down:
    ; handle down
    pop bp
    ret
.left:
    ; handle left
    pop bp
    ret
.right:
    ; handle right
    pop bp
    ret

; Function: update_player
update_player:
    push bp
    mov bp, sp
    ; update position based on input
    pop bp
    ret

; Function: draw_sprite
draw_sprite:
    push bp
    mov bp, sp
    ; draw player sprite at current position
    pop bp
    ret

; Function: check_collision
check_collision:
    push bp
    mov bp, sp
    ; check for collision with walls or enemies
    pop bp
    ret

rule:
, over `data/LEVEL-2/LEVEL-2_real_rollout.jsonl` in file
order:

1. at least two error tags (coexisting errors), every tag a value error that
   corrupts a node's output (parameter type/name/value, missing parameter,
   wrong tool name/selection, wrong or missing dependency, wrong
   parallelization); missing-tool, redundant-call, exception-handling, and
   wrong-serialization records are excluded because no single node output is
   wrong;
2. the plan parses, every dependency exists, and it has 3 to 12 tool nodes;
3. the error analysis names at least two distinct tool nodes; the first two
   named are the fault sites;
4. the two sites' cones (the node and its descendants, excluding the final
   response) are classified as nested, overlapping, or disjoint, and the first
   four records of each class are taken: two `dev`, two held-out `test`.
